Shreyas Iyer on India's Ireland Series Loss

Cricketer Shreyas Iyer has commented on India's unexpected series loss in Ireland. He admitted to being surprised by the outcome, stating that the team did not anticipate Ireland playing as well as they did. Iyer suggested he has identified reasons for the defeat.
